A personal conversation

The teaching centres on the Creator within the game of experiences. Its explanations and practices are freely available here. If you have explored them and still prefer a personal conversation, the existing option is described below.

Practical details

An introductory reflection conversation is 30 minutes and ₹500. The available formats are phone, Zoom, WhatsApp call, or offline by arrangement. Availability is 9 am–10 pm (IST). Individual or group conversations can be discussed case by case.

Arrange a suitable time before paying: pudaykumar12@gmail.com or WhatsApp +91 9989766517.

This is spiritual reflection and personal development, not therapy or crisis support.

Payment information

After arranging the conversation, the existing Razorpay payment page is available. If you have paid, share only your payment reference. Never send card numbers, bank details, OTPs, or passwords.

If the same customer accidentally pays twice for the same introductory conversation, the duplicate payment will be refunded within 1–2 days.
